name: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd.
blurb: Shin-Etsu Chemical is a Japanese diversified chemical conglomerate and one of the world's largest chemical companies by market capitalization. Its two dominant businesses are polyvinyl chloride (PVC), where it holds the global number-one position, and semiconductor silicon wafers, where it is likewise the world's leading supplier. The company also produces silicones, rare-earth magnets, and cellulose derivatives, serving industries ranging from construction and electronics to automotive and pharmaceuticals. Its consistent profitability and conservative balance sheet have made it a benchmark blue-chip within Japanese equities.
